THIS CAUSED A DISCHARGE OF BETWEEN 80 AND 100 GALLONS OF DIESEL ONTO THE STREET AND INTO A NEARBY STORM DRAIN. A CITY ENGINEER RESPONDED AND VERIFIED THAT THE STORM DRAINS ONLY LEAD TO THE RETENTION POND AND THAT CURRENTLY THE DIESEL IS STUCK IN THE STORM DRAIN. THE CONTRACTOR HAS BEEN HIRED AND IS IN ROUTE TO ADDRESS THE INCIDENT.
